title: No official price source exists
detail: nfl.com has no odds page, so every market number in this repository is a third-party mirror
handling: Every gate that needs a price is marked price_basis and reported with its real-price share

title: No official league depth chart
detail: Club depth pages are club-published and captioned unofficial; the league page 404s
handling: Depth is modelled from playing time once snap counts are captured; listed rank is used only as a labelled secondary source

title: Forward-dated prices in the mirror are untimed and implausibly far from the model
detail: 15 unplayed 2026 fixtures carry a spread and total; 8 of 13 Week 11 games disagree with our line by more than 8 points (max 18.4)
handling: Excluded from every gate; published on the pricing page with the deviation column so a reviewer can see them

title: The injury mirror carries no per-row fetch timestamp
detail: So 'known before kickoff' for the availability feature is an assumption about the league's publication cadence, not a certified fact
handling: Capture the report itself three times a week and store the timestamps; until then the availability feature is labelled assumption-bound

title: Week 10 injury rows disagree between sources
detail: The mirror holds 18 rows across 4 clubs for 2026 Week 10; the official page renders 8 chunks of tables; earlier sections published 254 rows and claimed 279 live
handling: Full re-capture with a per-team row count (SG-09); no row count is asserted here because none could be re-derived from the mirror

title: Three Lions designations were published blank
detail: Live report shows Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed each as Out with a DNP practice designation
handling: Fixed: values transcribed with their clock time; the older tables remain stale and their owners should re-capture

title: One Week 10 result is unverified
detail: At capture the Steelers-Bengals game centre and the schedule page both printed a kickoff time and no score; Ravens-Chargers had not been played
handling: Both rows are carried with blank scores and a status, never a guessed number

title: The schedule page's own venue widget contradicts its international label
detail: The Week 10 Patriots-Lions block is labelled International Game - Munich while its venue link targets Ford Field; the mirror has no row for that fixture
handling: Venue is transcribed from the game centre only (2 of 148 so far); R23 stays blocked until the capture covers every fixture

title: Depth parser drops 2025 and 2026 entirely
detail: aggregate_report.json reports depth_charts_2026.csv as 784796 rows x 12 columns; the committed depth_player.csv contains 0 rows for 2026
handling: Fix the parser to branch on the header and fail the build when a season yields zero rows (SG-03)

title: No 2026 playing-time data in the repository
detail: snap_season.json stops at 2017; snap_participation.csv lists participants with no snap counts
handling: Acquire per-game snap counts in CI (SG-02); until then replacement depth is not modelled

title: Reserve lists are absent from the availability feed
detail: 0 rows carry a reserve status in 42179 mirror rows, and the report itself lists only Out/Questionable/Probable/Doubtful
handling: A per-club reserve capture is required so an unlisted player is never read as healthy

title: A one-season gate almost aborted a correct sign convention
detail: 2026 home-cover is 40.9% of 137 graded games; the convention check is sized on 3,031 graded games (47.25% cover) where the sign holds
handling: Gates are now sample-sized and the 2026 number is published as a finding, not a gate

title: No strategy shows skill on the frozen corpus
detail: Brier skill vs the devigged market: side -5.5%, total -4.6%, moneyline +6.5%, every cluster interval spanning zero
handling: Nothing is promoted; the leaderboard stays an empty escrow and the numbers live on the evaluation page only

title: A prior session's 32/32 replay is as-of, not absolute
detail: Their 137-game replay matched official standings; ours matches at 148 because the Sunday-night result had not been published at capture
handling: Every table now carries a capture clock time and the reconciliation states which games it excludes

title: A sign error was invisible to every convention check and visible only in one diagnostic
detail: The first version subtracted the opponent's defensive deviation instead of adding it. Price-convention checks stayed green; the symptom was corr(model, market) turning negative and MAE vs actual near 13 points
handling: Fixed by re-deriving the expectation terms; a model-sanity gate now aborts the build when corr(model,market) <= 0.55 or when the model looks sharper than the market, so this class of error cannot ship silently again
